data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 68.5m (2014: GBP 83.1m) is an improvement of GBP 9.0m (2014: improvement of GBP 6.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to beneficial developments in prior year reserves across the Marine and Transport classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: Beneficial developments in prior year reserves
prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable developments across prior year reserves, principally in the Marine and Transport classes, resulting in an improvement to prior year reserves.
Resolution of certain legacy issues which had an appreciable favourable impact on incurred claims.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a small gross release in prior-year reserves for 2015 of approximately GBP 4.9m (about 2.18% of opening gross claims outstanding). This release was driven by favourable prior-year developments, principally within the Marine/Transport portfolios and aided by the resolution of certain legacy issues and a benign catastrophe season. Note that the Managing Agent quotes a GBP 9.0m improvement on a net basis; the gross movement has been calculated from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: The improvement is driven by benign catastrophe experience, beneficial developments of GBP 9.0m in prior year reserves and favourable loss ratios across the newly re-positioned portfolio.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development gross figure was not stated explicitly as a gross amount in the narrative (the report quotes a net improvement of GBP 9.0m). A gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note 22). The net improvement cited in the technical provisions is GBP 9.0m (net of reinsurance); triangle-derived gross PYD is approximately -GBP 4.908m (release). The triangle excludes the aggregated '2010 and prior' column from analysis per instructions. If a gross movement note had been explicitly provided it would be preferred; this result is computed from the gross triangle.
